title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.06226v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-sho

translated_title: LeAVJEPA：一种用于视听自监督学习的极简架构
translated_abstract: 此前的视听自监督学习方法依赖于诸如EMA目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等机制。我们提出了LeAVJEPA，这是首个在LeJEPA无坍塌目标下训练的视听编码器。单个早期融合的Vision Transformer即可处理音频、视频以及联合的音视频输入。模态丢弃技术将缺失的模态视为同一事件的另一种视图，使跨模态对齐隐式地蕴含在目标函数之中。该模型将全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入对齐，并通过SIGReg防止表征坍塌。受控消融实验证实模态丢弃是实现视听对齐的关键机制。尽管架构极为简洁，LeAVJEPA在冻结评估下于AudioSet-20K上达到36.0 mAP，在ESC-50上达到91.3%的准确率。微调后，它在VGGSound上达到61.1%的准确率，且其嵌入支持零样本任务。
tldr: LeAVJEPA是一种极简的视听自监督学习架构，仅使用单个早期融合的Vision Transformer，结合模态丢弃与LeJEPA无坍塌目标实现隐式跨模态对齐，并在AudioSet-20K、ESC-50和VGGSound等多个基准上取得了优异性能。
en_tdlr: LeAVJEPA is a minimalist audio-visual self-supervised architecture that uses a single early-fusion Vision Transformer with modality dropout and LeJEPA's collapse-free objective for implicit cross-modal alignment, achieving strong performance on AudioSet-20K, ESC-50, and VGGSound benchmarks.
